standing: Leads the AFC East by 4 games

lastGame.title: Bills 26, Dolphins 9
stats: Josh Allen: 27-of-45, 304 yards, 1 TD, 2 INT; threw to eight different receivers and had no rushing attempts
DJ Moore: 8 catches, 91 yards, 4-yard TD; Khalil Shakir 5 catches for 101 yards; Ty Johnson 7 catches for 55 yards
James Cook III: 89 rushing yards and a 1-yard TD, his 10th rushing TD of the season
Tyler Bass: 4-of-5 on field goals (54, 43, 40, 28); a 54-yard miss ended his streak of 33 straight makes
Defense: 185 yards allowed, Miami 2-of-14 on third down, Kyle McCord 12-of-33 for 102 yards; Greg Rousseau 2 sacks, Damar Hamlin INT; no TD allowed since Nov 1

news.h: Five Bills questionable for Thanksgiving night
news.b: Wednesday's final report lists CB Christian Benford, TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb, ankle), DT T.J. Sanders (shoulder), RG O'Cyrus Torrence (ankle) and LB Dorian Williams (calf) as questionable. Nine of the 14 players first listed were full participants Wednesday and cleared to play.

news.h: Hairston ready if Benford can't go
news.b: Second-year CB Maxwell Hairston would start if Benford sits. Defensive coordinator Jim Leonhard said Hairston's game against Miami was "probably the most consistent he's been all season." Austin Corbett is likely first up if Torrence, who has never missed a start in 61 games, can't play.

news.h: Chiefs rule out Kenneth Walker III
news.b: Kansas City ruled out RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) for a third straight game, along with RT Jaylon Moore (ankle) and DT Omarr Norman-Lott. RG Trey Smith appears set to return from a concussion; TE Noah Gray and DL Peter Woods are questionable.

news.h: Bills favored by 3 for Thanksgiving night
news.b: FanDuel had Buffalo as a 3-point favorite over Kansas City (8-2) as of Nov. 23, with the total at 50.5 and the Bills at −149 on the moneyline. The 9-1 Bills hold the AFC's No. 1 seed going into tonight's 8:20 p.m. ET kickoff on NBC at Highmark Stadium.

source: Wednesday final injury reports (Yahoo Sports, NFL.com, Heavy), Fox Sports Thanksgiving odds (FanDuel), AFC East records via Yahoo Sports; earlier recaps from ESPN and AP (checked Nov 26).
